title: Leveraging AI workflows to build and release a game.
author: Repolak

comments.author: Repolak
comments.body: Has anyone shipped something utilizing AI? We have been building this game and got to push our first public builds out. It’s been an incredible experience but the nerves of it being public definitely make you crazy!

comments.author: AgenticGameDev
comments.body: Congratulations! Yes AI dev is scarry. Especially when you do major refactoring and mid way through get repeat errors. Troubleshooting that suck. What was your major takeaway?

replies.author: Repolak
replies.body:
I think my biggest takeaway is that Ai currently is powerful, but not smart. 
So incredibly good at exactly what you tell them, but horrid at assumption. 

Hindsight and all that, but figuring that out unlocked probably a double in my production speed.
